q1.q: How long does an implementation take?
q1.a: Most projects are live within 2 to 3 weeks. We start with a free audit (30 min), define the scope in week one, and deliver in week two or three. For more complex projects with multiple agents or integrations, timelines can extend to 4-6 weeks.

q2.q: Do I need technical or AI knowledge to work with you?
q2.a: Not at all. Our job is to translate your business needs into technical solutions. You just need to know your process well — we handle the rest. Many of our clients have no internal tech team.

q3.q: Is my data safe? Do you comply with GDPR?
q3.a: Yes. We work with infrastructure that uses encryption in transit and at rest, and we never use your data to train external models. All projects are designed with GDPR compliance by default. If you operate in regulated sectors (health, finance, legal), we'll outline the additional safeguards required.

q4.q: How do I know if my business is ready for AI?
q4.a: If you have tasks that repeat more than 3 times a week, processes that depend on copying data between tools, or your team spends hours answering the same questions — you're ready. The free audit is designed to identify exactly where AI has the most impact in your specific case.

q5.q: What happens if something stops working after delivery?
q5.a: All our projects include a post-delivery warranty period. If something fails on our end, we fix it at no extra cost. We also offer monthly maintenance plans so your automations evolve with your business and with changes to the platforms you use.

q6.a: That's not the goal. AI eliminates mechanical, repetitive work — reports, copy-paste, standard replies — so your team can focus on what truly adds value: client relationships, strategy, creativity. Our clients don't let anyone go; their teams simply stop doing the most frustrating work.

q7.q: What is NOT automating actually costing me?
q7.a: More than you think. If a repetitive task takes 5 hours a week for someone earning €20/h, that's €400/month — nearly €5,000/year — in work an automation does by itself. And that doesn't count errors, delays, and opportunities lost because your team has no time. Projects start from €499, and ROI is usually visible in the first month. In the audit we calculate the real cost of inaction together, before you decide anything.

q8.q: What tools and platforms do you use?
q8.a: We work with the leading tools in the industry: n8n and Make for automations, OpenAI and Claude for conversational agents, Supabase and Airtable for data, and WhatsApp Business API, HubSpot or Slack for integrations. We adapt to your existing stack — we don't force you to change what works.
